messages:
harper: quick follow-up from the policy sync \u2014 proposal: add a "micro-qualifier" stage after scoring to break ties and gently bias routing for latency/cost/region. Keep it tiny, observable, and opt-in per tenant.

diego: +1 on a micro-qualifier. two must-haves: deterministic default for debuggability, and a seeded option to mitigate chronic hotspotting. also, don't introduce extra network calls.

sylvie: agreed. runtime constraints: pure function, no IO, bounded CPU (target < 120us), and idempotent. if it errors or times out runtime should apply neutral semantics and increment qualifier.failure.

harper: config sketch for the addendum: 
```
qualifier_id: affinity_nudge_v1
version: "1"
mode: seeded  # deterministic | seeded | probabilistic
expr: "score + bias * (region_score - cost_norm)"
params:
  bias: 0.08
```
we'll treat missing qualifier as no-op so backward compatibility is trivial.

diego: control-plane should statically validate expressions and emit bytecode for sidecars. whitelist ops: add, mul, clamp, lerp, seeded_hash. reject loops, syscalls, and any random external references.

sylvie: telemetry: emit qualifier.{tenant}.{id}.applied (bool), qualifier.{tenant}.{id}.delta_score (histogram), qualifier.{tenant}.{id}.failure_count, and include both original_score and adjusted_score in the trace logs for a subset of requests.

harper: rollout plan: feature-flagged UI -> internal tenants -> 72h sim with production-shaped traffic -> low-traffic prod tenants opt-in -> wider opt-in. Keep flag default-off.

diego: tests: unit evals, p95 microbench, sim harness that asserts no >15% backend skew vs baseline, and chaos test where evaluator panics to ensure neutral fallback.

sylvie: ops alerts: qualifier.failure_rate > 0.5% and qualifier.applied_rate drift > 10% vs sim baseline. add a quick rollback: flip tenant flag off, sidecar reload if necessary. document playbook.

harper: implementation note: prefer sidecar-first (per-tenant bytecode) to enable rapid opt-ins and safer blasts. central-router path can be added later once we assess perf and operational cost.

diego: small design question: should qualifiers be able to reference short-lived probe signals (eg region_probe_score)? i'd say no for first iteration; use only stable, pre-ingested scores to keep eval pure and deterministic.

sylvie: +1. Avoid transient inputs initially. Also add a version field on qualifier so we can change semantics and have a migration plan.

harper: example telemetry naming in the addendum: 
- route.qualifier.applied
- route.qualifier.delta_score
- route.qualifier.failure_count
- trace.tag.qualifier_id
we'll include a short JSON example in the RFC addendum.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: qualifier-micro-stage branch pushed to staging (https://redwood-infra/changes/qualifier-micro-stage) :rocket:

harper: next steps: i'll write the addendum with schema, telemetry, and rollout steps. @diego please prototype a seeded_hash RNG and microbench. @sylvie can you draft the ops runbook and alerts?

diego: will prototype today and post numbers by EOD.

sylvie: drafting runbook now, will include migration and rollback steps.

harper: thanks all \u2014 keep it small and measurable, iterate biases after we have reliable telemetry. :thumbsup:
